Need a ≥ 1? Check if a≥1, then any x≤1 implies x≤a? Actually ¬p x∈[-3,1], all x≤1≤a, so x≤a true. ¬q includes (-∞,a]; if a>1, includes (1,a], if a=1 includes (-∞,-3) too; B not subset A. Thus a≥1. 由 \(p:|x+1|>2\) 得  
\[
p:x>1 \text{ 或 } x<-3
\]
所以
\[
\neg p:-3\le x\le 1
\]

由 \(q:x>a\) 得
\[
\neg q:x\le a
\]

\(\neg p\) 是 \(\neg q\) 的充分不必要条件，说明满足 \(\neg p\) 的 \(x\) 一定满足 \(\neg q\)，且不能反过来，即
\[
[-3,1]\subsetneq (-\infty,a]
\]
因此需要
\[
a\ge 1
\]

答案：A
